# Angular SDK Components

> Source for @pega/angular-sdk-components (PConnect bridge + Angular Material components) and @pega/angular-sdk-overrides, used by the Pega Constellation Angular SDK (github.com/pegasystems/angular-sdk). Angular 21, zoneless, standalone components, TypeScript.

Start with AGENTS.md: it has the project map, the verification loop (`node scripts/verify.js`), the definition of done, task recipes and the rules that must not be broken.

## Docs
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): instructions for AI coding agents and contributors
- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md): runtime flow, PCore/PConnect, bridge, component mapper
- [docs/components.md](docs/components.md): generated catalogue of every Pega component name and its Angular class
- [docs/testing.md](docs/testing.md): unit-test harness, mocks, static ratchets, E2E
- [docs/configuration.md](docs/configuration.md): sdk-config.json and SDK_* environment variables
- [docs/ci-cd.md](docs/ci-cd.md): pipelines, E2E in CI
- [docs/customizing.md](docs/customizing.md): override, add or edit components
- [docs/theming.md](docs/theming.md): Material 3 tokens
- [docs/troubleshooting.md](docs/troubleshooting.md)
- [docs/adr/](docs/adr/): architecture decisions and deferred work

## Key source locations
- packages/angular-sdk-components/src/public-api.ts: public exports
- packages/angular-sdk-components/src/lib/_bridge/: AngularPConnectService, ComponentMapperComponent, component maps
- packages/angular-sdk-components/src/lib/_components/{field,template,widget,infra,designSystemExtension}/
- etc/angular-sdk-components.api.md: committed public API report (generated)
- scripts/: build, verification and tooling scripts

## Optional
- [.github/instructions/](.github/instructions/): area-specific rules (bridge, components, testing, build scripts)
- [.github/agents/](.github/agents/): sdk-engineer (the single expert agent)
- [.github/skills/](.github/skills/): sdk-pconnect-api and the Spec Kit skills
